reason: The first controlled v3 model used original occurrence-free KOST. Live KOST includes verified objectives, so its input contract cannot silently be changed at deployment. Test this directly related input correction prospectively on development data only.
arms: A: exact frozen v2 weights on fully objective-corrected KOST inputs
B: fixed-alpha raw nine-family ridge on the same corrected inputs plus verified player objectives
features: Same nine-family design; no multikill/opening/trade/operator changes. KOST is recomputed from verified normalized objectives in BOTH arms, not a new formula or a tenth feature.
split: Original frozen v2 training events and EWC development, same fully objective-complete/identity/KD-clean subset; APAC North final and both original September final events excluded
regularization: Standardize on training rows, unpenalized intercept, ridge alpha1. No search, no refit using final outcomes.
outputs: New model/report/log record. Preserve first v3 model/development/final failures and every original dataset; no live v2, SQLite or public data change.
final_policy: This is development only. If selected for a future final, reserve a genuinely new event and freeze before its errors. APAC North Stage2 is permanently consumed. No automatic deployment.
